''See also: [[Eithan Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Eithan [[Arelius family|Arelius]], also known by his full name [[Tiberian Arelius|Ozmanthus Tiberian Mereithan Arelius]], is a powerful and eccentric [[Underlord]] belonging to the prominent [[Arelius family]]. A core descendant of his house, he has served the [[Blackflame Empire]] and acted as an advisor to the former [[Monarch]], [[Tiberian Arelius]]. Known for his brilliant, sunny demeanor and tendency toward playful or disruptive behavior, he often masks his true strength behind a [[veil]] to appear ordinary. Despite this, he possesses immense spiritual [[Authority|authority]] and advanced observational capabilities attributed to his bloodline, which allow him to perceive his surroundings with extreme precision. Eithan has taken [[Lindon|Wei Shi Lindon]] and [[Yerin]] under his protection, acting as a mentor and claiming them as his apprentices. His legacy is tied to significant cosmic events, including his transition into the heavens and his reputation as a figure of immense power, sometimes referred to as the [[Reaper of Worlds]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Eithan is a well-dressed man with blond hair, though his hair has since become pure white. He wears various outfits ranging from expensive white shadesilk and teal or turquoise outer robes with golden fish embroidery to intricate red ensembles with gold star patterns, gray fighting robes, and [[Skysworn armor]]. He has been seen in black armor and can appear with a broken, bruised, and blood-caked body.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Eithan is a smiling opponent who considers [[Lindon]] to be a gamble. He has abandoned his missions in an effort to raise up people who could replace him and is known for noting the tradeoffs inherent in all [[cycling]] methods.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Eithan is the adopted brother and teacher of [[Lindon]], whom he has monitored and provided with various techniques. He is the teacher and adoptive father of [[Yerin]], and he has also served as a teacher to two apprentices. He is a friend of [[Orthos]], the cousin of [[Veris Arelius]], and the superior to [[Mercy]] in the [[Abidan]]. Additionally, he has interacted with [[Fisher Gesha|Gesha]], [[Jai Daishou]], [[Naru Gwei]], [[Bai Rou]], [[Naru Cassias Arelius|Cassias]], [[Jing]], [[Naru Saeya]], and [[Dross]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As a [[sacred artist]] and Overlord, Eithan utilizes the [[Hollow Armor]] and [[Hollow Spear]] techniques, as well as the [[Empty Palm]]. He possesses superior awareness through a detection web and can use an [[Enforcer binding]] to launch himself. His skills include using [[soulfire]] to reinforce constructs or heal, performing absolute strikes, and utilizing a [[void key]] for item storage.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Blackflame City}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Eithan is a blond-haired man dressed in expensive white shadesilk imported from the west, who utilizes webs of his power to gather information and an [[Enforcer technique]] to drift slowly toward the ground.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c6">''Soulsmith'', chapter 6</ref> Utilizing a power inherited from his father's line, he can use an [[Enforcer binding]] to launch himself.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c9">''Soulsmith'', chapter 9</ref> After consuming a liquid that tastes like distilled poison, he refers to [[Lindon]] as 'elder brother' and claims the ability to see the present.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c13">''Soulsmith'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14">''Soulsmith'', chapter 14</ref> Clad in white-and-blue robes, Eithan possesses a superior awareness and thousand eyes that allow him to know everything within range of his spirit.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14" /> His clan organizes street sweepers in [[Blackflame City]], and while he looks for promising recruits, he demonstrates the strength to tear metal with his bare hands.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c15">''Soulsmith'', chapter 15</ref> He can approach without being felt due to a collar's effect and uses wrought [[Iron|iron]] fabric scissors as a weapon.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c15" /> The [[yellow-haired man]] has helped [[Lindon]], noting that the latter's throat was not as far gone as he had thought and observing his transition to [[Iron]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c16">''Soulsmith'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c17">''Soulsmith'', chapter 17</ref> Eithan [[Arelius family|Arelius]] is a [[sacred artist]] and an [[Underlord]] in service of the [[Blackflame Empire]] who serves as the heir to the [[Arelius family]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c18">''Soulsmith'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c19">''Soulsmith'', chapter 19</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Skysworn Shores}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Eithan [[Arelius family|Arelius]] is a figure whose handwriting was discovered in the Deepwalker Ape's prison, and he masks his power by wrapping his core in a [[veil]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c1">''Skysworn'', chapter 1</ref> The narrator has felt rage toward him, and he is seen with a tiny blue spirit resting on his head.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c2">''Skysworn'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c3">''Skysworn'', chapter 3</ref> After painting a picture of an ancient stone building atop a lonely, flat-summit mountain, he informed [[Lindon]] that he lacks a [[Goldsign]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c3" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c4">''Skysworn'', chapter 4</ref> Using black scissors, Eithan became the primary target of the [[Skysworn Underlord]]'s technique and appeared to [[Lindon]]'s [[Spiritual sight|spiritual sight]] as a sun of green [[Wind aura|wind aura]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c5">''Skysworn'', chapter 5</ref> The second-ranked [[Underlord]] on these shores released a pulse of [[pure madra]] from his chest and used [[pure madra]] from his fist to strike [[Naru Gwei]] in the chest.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c5" /> He emits a wave of mostly blue-white and colorless [[madra]] and has been seen entering rooms holding a pure white knife.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c6">''Skysworn'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c7">''Skysworn'', chapter 7</ref> Eithan noted that the timing of certain events depends on the approach of a [[Dreadgod]], and he was later located below the house.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c7" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c8">''Skysworn'', chapter 8</ref> While using a [[Striker technique]], he was wounded in the shoulder by a red hook.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c9">''Skysworn'', chapter 9</ref> He sealed [[Yerin's belt]] and may possess knowledge on how to turn someone into a [[Truegold]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c10">''Skysworn'', chapter 10</ref> As he fights emissaries and [[Underlord|Underlords]], Eithan has been recalled to a secret location by the Emperor's order.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c10" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c11">''Skysworn'', chapter 11</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Serving as Cassia's [[Underlord]], Eithan viewed the emergence of the [[Blood Shadow]] as a potential opportunity for [[Yerin]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c16">''Skysworn'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c17">''Skysworn'', chapter 17</ref> He operates under the belief that those who are strong are the ones who write the rules.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c18">''Skysworn'', chapter 18</ref> During their interaction, Eithan touched [[Yerin]] using a marble.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c18" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Eithan's name offers a degree of protection for [[Lindon]], even as Eithan has spent the previous weeks contemplating a specific idea.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c2">''Ghostwater'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c4">''Ghostwater'', chapter 4</ref> He is the sole individual willing to inquire about [[Renfei]]'s death and intends to address [[Redmoon Hall]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c6">''Ghostwater'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c7">''Ghostwater'', chapter 7</ref> After discussing tiger-chasing, Eithan received thanks from [[Lindon]] for the [[Heaven and Earth Purification Wheel]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c8">''Ghostwater'', chapter 8</ref> Eithan guided [[Lindon]] to the [[Bloodforged Iron body]] while warning him that others might attempt to kill him to extract his [[cycling technique]] from his [[Remnant]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c9">''Ghostwater'', chapter 9</ref> Regarding advancements, Eithan is noted in relation to the depth of cores.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c13">''Ghostwater'', chapter 13</ref> Acting on behalf of the Emperor of the [[Blackflame Empire]], Eithan [[Arelius family|Arelius]] uses [[soulfire]] to reinforce constructs and carries a blue umbrella made of waxed fabric.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c14">''Ghostwater'', chapter 14</ref> He utilizes his folded umbrella as a weapon and observes that everything eventually ends.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c14" /> Eithan is a person whom [[Yerin]] cannot catch up to, and he is expected at the Emperor's audience hall.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c17">''Ghostwater'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c19">''Ghostwater'', chapter 19</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Skysworn missions}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Eithan is a skilled user of [[veil|veils]] who possesses a disciple described as a young [[Blackflame]] contracted to a sacred turtle.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c4">''Underlord'', chapter 4</ref> After reaching out to lay a hand on [[Bai Rou]], he explains that [[Skysworn]] require an assignment for squad registration and offers the choice between training to reach [[Underlord]] or undertaking secret missions for [[The Empire|the Empire]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c4" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5">''Underlord'', chapter 5</ref> Equipped with [[Skysworn armor]] and a [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]], he utilizes a [[void key]] for storing items and uses a [[scripted fire-starter]] to light his pipe.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5" /> The former [[Jai Patriarch|Patriarch]] of the [[Akura clan]]'s [[Blackflame]] branch, who was ousted from his position, commissioned [[Lezaar]] to craft a specific pill.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c6">''Underlord'', chapter 6</ref> While leading a pack of young [[Truegold|Truegolds]] in [[emerald armor]], he teaches [[Lindon]] various techniques.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c6" /> As [[Lindon]]'s master, Eithan follows a sixteen-step plan for perfecting him as a [[Gold]] and leads him to unclaimed natural treasure deposits.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8">''Underlord'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c9">''Underlord'', chapter 9</ref> He informs [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]] that many potential [[Underlord|Underlords]] fail to realize their true revelation due to a lack of [[soulfire]], noting that he serves either the Emperor or the [[Arelius family]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c9" /> Duty-bound to a [[Skysworn]] scouting mission, he is present during a conversation between [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c11">''Underlord'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c12">''Underlord'', chapter 12</ref> Eithan [[Arelius family|Arelius]] has two apprentices and leads [[Lindon]] through a massive camp outside the city walls to [[Fisher Gesha]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c13">''Underlord'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c14">''Underlord'', chapter 14</ref> Interacting with both [[Lindon]] and [[Dross]], he intends to rob the Emperor's vaults and is expected to return with the [[Arelius technique library]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c14" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c15">''Underlord'', chapter 15</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Uncrowned King tournament}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Eithan is a competitor in the [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned King tournament]] who advised [[Lindon]] to keep his [[Jade cycling technique]] secret.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c2">''Uncrowned'', chapter 2</ref> Possessing cores like deep lakes and a lifeline resembling a thousand-year [[ancestral tree]], Eithan [[Arelius family|Arelius]] achieved perfect scores on every mental test.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c2" /> While facing [[Yerin]] in the [[Skysworn practice arena]], he wore an intricate red ensemble patterned with gold stars.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c2" /> After sensing [[Dross]]'s presence, it became clear that Eithan is a person in the city capable of challenging either [[Yerin]] or [[Naru Saeya]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c4">''Uncrowned'', chapter 4</ref> Having spent his childhood learning to restrict his physical senses, he can manifest blue-white stars of [[Forged madra]] that dissipate back into aura.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c4" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c8">''Uncrowned'', chapter 8</ref> Ranked sixty-fourth in the tournament, Eithan is a member of the [[Blackflame team]] who is currently designing a flying fortress for the [[Ninecloud Soul]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c12">''Uncrowned'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c13">''Uncrowned'', chapter 13</ref> During combat, he redirected a stream of [[water madra]] and was dissolved into [[white light]] before emerging at the edge of the jungle.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c13" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15">''Uncrowned'', chapter 15</ref> Eithan utilizes an [[Archlord sacred dagger]] capable of changing its physical shape, as well as scissors that carry an [[Archlord binding]] and respond well to [[Enforcement]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c17">''Uncrowned'', chapter 17</ref> A chosen of [[Akura Malice]] from the [[Blackflame Empire]], he is [[Veris Arelius]]'s cousin.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c18">''Uncrowned'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c19">''Uncrowned'', chapter 19</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Blackflame Empire competition}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Eithan, a member of the [[Arelius family]] who has spent much of his life in the [[Blackflame Empire]], was found lounging in a padded chair in [[Lindon]]'s room.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3">''Wintersteel'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c15">''Wintersteel'', chapter 15</ref> As [[Lindon]]'s teacher, he had been instructed to prepare for a fight the following morning as part of a competition.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3" /> While wearing gray fighting robes, he utilized the [[Empty Palm]] and [[Hollow King's Crown]] techniques, having previously warned his students that he would not hold back.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c4">''Wintersteel'', chapter 4</ref> He possessed a stopwatch device and had previously been under the protection of [[Northstrider]] and [[Malice]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c4" /> After insisting that [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]] meet at a restaurant, Eithan was notably absent from the matches held throughout the week.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c6">''Wintersteel'', chapter 6</ref> During a ceremony, he wore bright ocean-shaded robes, and watching him fight prompted [[Lindon]] to consider the direction of his own [[pure madra]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7">''Wintersteel'', chapter 7</ref> Eithan eventually gathered with [[Yerin]] and [[Mercy]] at the end of a [[cloudship]] dock, where he used his temporary access to the [[technique library]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8">''Wintersteel'', chapter 8</ref> Upon advancing to the rank of Overlord through the use of [[soulfire]], he revealed himself as one who sees.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c15" /> He provided perception training to [[Yerin]], though he noted that he did not yet see [[Sage]] potential in her.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8" /> An Overlord who uses [[cycling]] [[madra]], Eithan's clothes were destroyed by a [[destruction aura]], leaving him with a cloud condensed from aura around his waist.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c11">''Wintersteel'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c15" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Journey into darkness}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Eithan, an [[Archlord]], traveled with [[Lindon]], [[Mercy]], and [[Fury]] into a [[pillar of darkness]] aboard one of the world's fastest cloudships.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18">''Wintersteel'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27">''Wintersteel'', chapter 27</ref> During the journey, he spoke to [[Lindon]] about seeing himself through the eyes of others and may have extended his [[pure madra]] to cover the vessel.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c19">''Wintersteel'', chapter 19</ref> He is capable of waving people aboard his ship and can drift downward on a flow of [[Wind aura|wind aura]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c19" /> Having previously given [[Yerin]] [[dream tablets]], Eithan's own safety is now dependent on her victory.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c21">''Wintersteel'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c22">''Wintersteel'', chapter 22</ref> Utilizing pressure as a focused weapon, he remained at [[Lindon]]'s bedside upon the latter's awakening and even questioned if a copy of [[Yerin]] remains her true self.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c23">''Wintersteel'', chapter 23</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c25">''Wintersteel'', chapter 25</ref> Mentioned in connection to the plans of [[Malice]], Eithan dove and rolled toward the group before launching a [[Hollow King]]'s Spear.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26">''Wintersteel'', chapter 26</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27" /> To combat [[Blood aura|blood aura]], he employed both [[soulfire]] and [[madra]], even using the [[Hollow King]]'s Mantle to deflect a flying hawk of blood.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27" /> Following the combat, Eithan was found on the [[cloudship]] dock with [[Lindon]], lying on the floor bleeding with ragged breathing.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28">''Wintersteel'', chapter 28</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">19</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Eithan]] travels with [[Lindon]], [[Mercy]], and [[Fury]] into a [[pillar of darkness]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The Labyrinth}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Eithan believes that [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]]'s function has been intentionally modified.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c9">''Reaper'', chapter 9</ref> Walking into [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]] with an arm around [[Lindon]], he carries a marble containing darkness.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c10">''Reaper'', chapter 10</ref> While he is a genius [[Soulsmith]], Eithan remains vulnerable to [[Enforcer techniques]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c11">''Reaper'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c12">''Reaper'', chapter 12</ref> As he looks into the darkness, he indicates that a chamber serves as a way through.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c12" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c13">''Reaper'', chapter 13</ref> Dressed in fine pink-and-blue silks, he utilizes the [[Hollow Spear]] and can drop stars of [[pure madra]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c16">''Reaper'', chapter 16</ref> During combat, he has blasted a trident from the air and projected the [[Hollow Spear]] technique through his scissors.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c16" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17">''Reaper'', chapter 17</ref> Although his armor was dissolving during a fight with [[Reigan Shen]], Eithan possesses [[Icons]] that nearly formed; if fully manifested, these would have made him a [[Sage]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17" /> He is currently waiting for the [[Joy Icon]] because he does not wish to manifest the same [[Icons]] as [[Ozmanthus Arelius|Ozmanthus]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17" /> While pacing a hallway, he theorizes that [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]] cannot lock them in and calls back regarding an opening exit.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c19">''Reaper'', chapter 19</ref> Eithan notes the presence of [[Dreadgod cults]] and the [[The Eight-Man Empire|Eight-Man Empire]], and it is known that he can be consumed to borrow his bloodline legacy.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c20">''Reaper'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c21">''Reaper'', chapter 21</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The Origin Shroud}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|While walking with [[Yerin]], Eithan is bound by the restrictions of an oath and possesses the ability to move at [[Archlord]] speed.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c23">''Reaper'', chapter 23</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c24">''Reaper'', chapter 24</ref> He witnessed a [[Shadow|shadow]] of himself ascending to the rank of [[Monarch]] and revealed that he had been holding a black marble.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c25">''Reaper'', chapter 25</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c26">''Reaper'', chapter 26</ref> Possessing the power of the [[Reaper]] and the vision of [[The Hound|the Hound]], he was once declared the heir of [[Spider of the Abidan|the Spider]], though his strength has faded from remaining under the [[Origin Shroud]] for an extended period.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c26" /> Known by the full name [[Tiberian Arelius|Ozmanthus Tiberian Mereithan Arelius]], he was once known as Ozriel and was called Eithan by his mother.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c26" /> An [[Abidan]] member, he used the palm of his hand to stop a cosmic attack.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c27">''Reaper'', chapter 27</ref> A vision within his marble showed Eithan [[Arelius family|Arelius]], a figure [[Malice]] identified as him, whose cosmic role was to put down worlds that were too sick to continue.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c27" /> Ultimately, Eithan [[Arelius family|Arelius]] abandoned this mission in an attempt to raise up individuals who could replace him.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c27" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Dreadgod}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|After ascending into the heavens to tend to a garden, Eithan demonstrated world-shaking power before vanishing.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3">''Dreadgod'', chapter 3</ref> The individual known as Eithan [[Arelius family|Arelius]] is actually [[Ozmanthus Arelius|Ozmanthus]], a figure who revealed himself to be a heavenly messenger.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c4">''Dreadgod'', chapter 4</ref> While [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] attempts to mimic him, Eithan has left [[scales]] behind for [[Little Blue]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c5">''Dreadgod'', chapter 5</ref> As a prominent and powerful member of the [[Abidan]], Eithan's plans cause concern for [[Malice]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7">''Dreadgod'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c8">''Dreadgod'', chapter 8</ref> He engaged a mysterious enemy in the sky and is mentioned by [[Mercy]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c8" /> [[Lindon]] compares [[Dross]]'s comments to Eithan and speculates that he might be able to hear [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c10">''Dreadgod'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c12">''Dreadgod'', chapter 12</ref> Regarding the [[Titan]], Eithan noted that it is characterized by inevitability rather than speed.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15">''Dreadgod'', chapter 15</ref> Eithan [[Arelius family|Arelius]], who has ascended, blinded [[Malice]]'s ability to see into the future and liberated a [[Soulforge]] from [[Reigan Shen]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21">''Dreadgod'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c22">''Dreadgod'', chapter 22</ref> Though [[Larian]]'s grin makes her look uncomfortably like him, Eithan [[Arelius family|Arelius]] has brought chaos to the world.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c22" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23">''Dreadgod'', chapter 23</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Labyrinth}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Eithan is currently navigating [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]] alongside [[Lindon]] while carrying the pride, sadness, and anger once held by [[Ozmanthus Arelius|Ozmanthus]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c2">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 2</ref> His body is blood-caked and bruised, yet he remains the superior to [[Mercy]] within the [[Abidan]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 6</ref> Having previously allowed [[Yan Shoumei]] to go from [[Sky's Edge]], Eithan holds a title concerning divine skill and has engaged in combat with a man who blotted out the stars.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 4</ref> He expressed dissatisfaction regarding the materials [[Lindon]] used for his bow, even though Eithan could have resolved the issue in seconds.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6" /> Now known as Ozriel, he possesses pure white hair and wears sleek black armor from the neck down.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 7</ref> While Eithan believes a victory for [[Lindon]] would cause the [[Vroshir]] to withdraw, [[Gadrael]]'s actions prevent [[Lindon]] from reaching him.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" /> Eithan once remodeled the interior of [[The Grave|the Grave]] with [[Lindon]] and claims to be the greatest craftsman in all the worlds.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref> He is capable of tearing open a [[sapphire]] hole in reality to travel through [[Way|the Way]], a process he once advised [[Lindon]] to let [[Way|the Way]] complete after working with a featureless fragment containing water, earth, and microscopic life.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">22</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] is currently in [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]] with [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c2" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] carries the anger, sadness, and pride that [[Ozmanthus Arelius|Ozmanthus]] carried.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c2" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]]'s body is broken, bruised, and blood-caked.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan|Eithan Arelius]] let [[Yan Shoumei]] go from [[Sky's Edge]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan|Eithan Arelius]] holds a title related to divine skill.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan|Eithan Arelius]] has fought a man who blotted out the stars.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] is [[Mercy]]'s superior in the [[Abidan]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] believes he will give [[Mercy]] the [[Silent King]]'s bow.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] complained about the lack of materials [[Lindon]] used for his bow.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] could resolve the problem in seconds.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]]'s hair is pure white instead of blond.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] wears sleek, black armor from the neck down.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] is now Ozriel.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Gadrael]]'s actions prevent [[Lindon]] from reaching [[Eithan]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] believes a victory by [[Lindon]] would cause the [[Vroshir]] to withdraw.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] has white hair.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] remodeled the interior of [[The Grave|the Grave]] with [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] claims to be the greatest craftsman in all the worlds.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] can tear open a [[sapphire]] hole in reality to travel through [[Way|the Way]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}</li>
